description: Deletes one or more vectors in a vector index.

researchLinks.description: Security Analysis of Amazon S3 Vectors and LLM Retrieval

securityImplications: Attackers might use DeleteVectors to erase stored vectors from an index, destroying the data behind a RAG knowledge base.

simulation.value: aws s3vectors delete-vectors --vector-bucket-name TrailDiscover --index-name TrailDiscover --keys TrailDiscover
